storyline.real: Prost wins; Lauda, from 11th on the grid, takes second and the title by half a point
storyline.headline: Lauda wins at Estoril and leaves no half-points in doubt

mastery.label: Take second with exactly one tyre stop

hidden.label: Take second without a lap at PUSH

eras.briefing: Estoril, October 1984, the last race. Lauda leads the championship by 3.5 points from his McLaren team-mate Prost and needs second place if Prost wins. He started 11th. Turbo cars have 220 litres for the race. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.
